name: simsa
description: SIMSA repository root: repository-level checks and the documentation site build

scripts.test: npm run test:manifest && npm run test:migration-manifest && npm run test:backup-core && npm run test:neon && npm run test:cloud-access && npm run test:vercel-deployment && npm run test:neon-backup && npm run test:ops
scripts.test:manifest: npm --prefix frontend exec -- vitest run src/lib/build-manifest.test.js
scripts.test:neon: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/neon-target.test.mjs scripts/neon-database.test.mjs scripts/neon-database-policy.test.mjs scripts/neon-first-admin.test.mjs scripts/neon-worker.test.mjs
scripts.test:ops: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/ops/neon-credential.test.mjs scripts/ops/rilis-neon.test.mjs scripts/ops/neon-role-rotation.postgres.test.mjs scripts/ops/release-source.test.mjs scripts/ops/vercel-release.test.mjs scripts/ops/release-smoke.test.mjs scripts/ops/release-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.build:full: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
